data.explanation: This is your official income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2024 from Finanzamt Beispielhausen. Based on your income and deductions, the tax office set your income tax at €7,012.00, and since €7,779.00 in wage tax (Lohnsteuer) was already withheld, you are owed a refund of €767.00, which should arrive on your known bank account shortly. If you disagree with the calculation, you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or electronically with the tax office — the app shows until when. If you do nothing, the assessment becomes final.

items.title: Deadline to object to the tax assessment (Einspruch)
items.action: If you disagree with the assessment, file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or electronically with Finanzamt Beispielhausen, or declare it to the record there.
items.consequence: The assessment becomes final and binding and can no longer be challenged.

data.summary: Finanzamt Beispielhausen issued the income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2024, setting income tax at €7,012.00 against €7,779.00 in wage tax already withheld, resulting in a refund of €767.00 to be paid to the known account shortly. An objection (Einspruch) can be filed within one month of notification.
